newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank leads Estonian share trade.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank leads Estonian share trade.

text.p: Shares in market leader Hansapank kept volumes high on the Estonian stock market on Tuesday although the index slipped again, dealers said.
Hansapank turned over more than five million kroons amid market volume on the main list of 7.5 million kroons. Its shares drifted higher to close at 95.05 kroons, versus 94.90 kroons.
The Tallinn stock exchange index fell 0.11 percent to 96.42.
Hansapank dealer Tonu Pekk said that block trades were affecting sentiment in the rest of the market.
"They drive the stock price higher and make investors more careful," he said.
Savings Bank, the second largest bank, turned over 1.2 million kroons but it eased to 36.95 kroons from 37.25.
The secondary free market saw trade of 3.2 million kroons, one of its highest levels for some time, with more than half of the business in Saku brewery.
Volume in its shares was 1.5 million kroons and it closed slightly higher at 34 kroons as investors anticipated the release at the end of this week of its first half results.
